imgDesc.text:
In areas within the Temple of Space, after selecting an object within the temple, you can
Hold and drag your Skill to drag that object along a
Spacelike Vector. After dragging for a certain distance,
maintain that distance
for a while until the Spacelike Vector is
fully charged.
Release the skill button at this moment to trigger spatial folding and change the state of various objects.

You can control various objects in areas within the Temple of Space.
Some of these objects cannot be affected during Co-Op Mode.
Seize certain objects within the Temple of Space to produce a variety of incredible effects at corresponding moments.
